column1: # Snowflake token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# value SnowflakeDocs.g4 names by class, where the docs write a <placeholder>.
# Keywords and punctuation are literals in the grammar and need no row.
# A sample of one name, string or number stands for its class when the docs
# judge reads a statement; a keyword or a sample of several tokens stands for
# itself. (reserved) marks a word the docs judge never reads as a name.

column3: unquoted identifier: a letter or _, then letters, digits, _ and $; a "double-quoted" one is a name too
single-quoted string constant; a $$dollar-quoted$$ one is a string too
an expression; the command pages give no expression grammar, so a constant
a query; the command pages give no query grammar beyond SELECT's list
a data type; INT is a synonym of NUMBER(38,0)
$<col_position>: a column of a staged file by its position
<object_type> in GRANT and SHOW GRANTS: an object type keyword
file://<path>/<file>: a local file or directory in PUT and GET, written without quotes
